def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - np.min(bins)
    remaining = np.where(remaining > 0, remaining, 1e-9)
    avg_utilization = np.mean(bins - remaining)
    normalized_remaining = remaining / (bins + 1e-9)
    deviation_from_avg = np.abs(normalized_remaining - avg_utilization / (np.mean(bins) + 1e-9))
    return 1 / (1 + deviation_from_avg)

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    avg_load = np.mean(bins)
    load_deviation = np.abs(bins - avg_load)
    can_fit = bins >= item
    # Normalize deviation and invert to prioritize smaller deviations (closer to average)
    normalized_deviation = load_deviation / (np.max(load_deviation) + 1e-9)
    priority_scores = 1 / (1 + normalized_deviation)
    # Only allow bins that can fit the item
    return np.where(can_fit, priority_scores, 0)

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    avg_load = np.mean(bins)
    load_deviation = np.abs(bins - avg_load)
    remaining_capacity = bins - item
    can_fit = remaining_capacity >= 0

    # Normalize deviation and remaining capacity
    normalized_deviation = load_deviation / (np.max(load_deviation) + 1e-9)
    normalized_remaining = remaining_capacity / (np.max(remaining_capacity) + 1e-9)

    # Combine scores: prioritize closeness to average and available space
    priority_scores = (1 - normalized_deviation) * 0.5 + normalized_remaining * 0.5

    # Only allow bins that can fit the item
    return np.where(can_fit, priority_scores, 0)

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - np.min(bins)
    remaining = np.where(remaining > 0, remaining, 1e-9)
    median_utilization = np.median(bins)
    normalized_remaining = remaining / (bins + 1e-9)
    deviation_from_median = np.abs(normalized_remaining - median_utilization / (np.mean(bins) + 1e-9))
    return 1 / (1 + deviation_from_median)
